name: suis_resolver_refs
description: Stage-2 cpsK/cps1L resolver references. Each entry is a verbatim slice of a public record; the diagnostic position is the third (wobble) base of codon 161, which distinguishes Trp161 (TGG) from Cys161 (TGT/TGC).

checksum.normalization: uppercase concatenated nucleotide sequence, ASCII-encoded, no header, no whitespace, no trailing newline

steps: Download the EMBL flatfile for accession.version from ENA.
Concatenate the sequence lines following the SQ line and uppercase them.
Reverse-complement the slice if strand is '-'. All four entries here are forward strand.
Verify length, sha256, diagnostic_codon and coding-sequence integrity before writing.

notes: The 1_vs_14 references declare diagnostic position 492 and the 2_vs_1_2 references 483. The 9 bp offset is real: the 1/14 references carry 9 extra bases at the 5' end. The positions are intentional and verified; they must not be unified.

cps2K and cps14K shipped with a two-base (TG) deletion relative to their source records, which frameshifted the 3' two thirds of each gene. `python scripts/resolver_refs.py repair` restores them offline and refuses to act on a sequence that does not hash to the recorded damaged state.
codon_index_in_reference is the codon number within THIS slice; canonical_residue is the CpsK residue it corresponds to. They differ for the 1_vs_14 references because of the 9 bp 5' extension.
